description: dehydrate: at SessionStart, one DEHYDRATE line at most once per nudge_cooldown_hours (default 24) when the cached plan has stale sessions or worktrees, and a detached, niced refresh of that cached plan when it is over refresh_after_hours (default 6) old. With auto_on_close (default on) the refresh first sweeps ended background sessions whose worktree branch is merged and dehydrates them, at most once per auto_sweep_minutes (default 10). The refresh is otherwise read-only unless config auto_apply is true. Every command exits 0 on every path. The module ./register.tsx (a mod) opens a searchable rehydrate picker on a bare /rehydrate and, when a session ends, kicks a detached auto-dehydrate of that session.
